checks.command: pnpm --dir services/wlt test && pnpm run guard:wlt-financial-boundary
checks.proves: WLT tests and financial boundary guard pass for field representative finance changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove authenticated runtime context propagation, operator UI or independent financial acceptance.
checks.passCriteria: Commands exit zero with field actor/context/payout targeted tests included on the resulting SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Any financial boundary, isolation, idempotency, repository or targeted test failure fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: app-field read own wallet/ledger/commissions; submit valid, over-limit, duplicate and payload-drift payout attempts; test WLT unavailable; control-panel finance.read lookup same field actor; attempt cross-actor/context denial.
checks.proves: Field representative finance is correctly scoped and recoverable through DSH-to-WLT at runtime.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not grant independent finance/product/release approval and does not cover captain COD.
checks.passCriteria: Only own authorized truth is exposed, valid payout records once, invalid cases fail precisely and operator readback matches WLT truth.
checks.failCriteria: Cross-actor disclosure, direct WLT call, local balance derivation, duplicate payout, false success or COD scope creep fails.
